zh-CN.title: 小程序界面全面对齐
items: 聊天、广场、用户详情、发言、设置与云端资源等页面现已统一采用网页端的视觉与交互语言
导航与操作区已适配微信原生胶囊，窄屏页面不再发生标题或按钮遮挡
城市气泡、活动、头像框与个人名片等素材现已在小程序中完整呈现

en.title: Mini Program interface parity
items: Chat, Square, profiles, statements, settings, and cloud resources now share the web app's visual and interaction language
Navigation and actions now avoid the native WeChat capsule on narrow screens
City bubbles, activities, avatar frames, and profile card artwork are now fully represented in the Mini Program
